items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1971-04-08
items.q: I joined his bands, and he gave me a place to stay there.

ctx.x: Where were you staying then? In a boarding house?

No, I was living in a place called Jack Kerry. He had a wooden coal place, and I was playing, I joined his bands, and he gave me a place to stay there. But it was pretty sad, though. Yeah. Oh, no, it was sad. It was sad.
How much did Jack call you, charge you to stay there?
